name: Coffered
description: A coffered ceiling: gilt-ribbed square coffers stepping down in two bevelled frames to painted blue and red floors, each holding a rosette.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --fl: @p(var(--color4), var(--color5)); background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color6) 0 5%, transparent 5% 95%, var(--color6) 95%), linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color6) 0 5%, transparent 5% 95%, var(--color6) 95%), conic-gradient(from -45deg, var(--color1) 0 90deg, var(--color2) 90deg 180deg, var(--color3) 180deg 270deg, var(--color2) 270deg 360deg); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 20%; background: linear-gradient(@var(--fl), @var(--fl)) 50% 50% / 58.3333% 58.3333% no-repeat, conic-gradient(from -45deg, var(--color1) 0 90deg, var(--color2) 90deg 180deg, var(--color3) 180deg 270deg, var(--color2) 270deg 360deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 33%; background: @p(var(--color6), var(--color3)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--ro); clip-path: @var(--ro); transform: rotate(@r(0deg, 45deg)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
